messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO alert: /v1/generate p99 latency breached 1.0s (5m window). Alert rule: realtime-p99-detect. Dashboard: <https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/p95p99|p95/p99 live>
sre-oncall: Ack. I'm picking this up — starting quick triage.
kim (SRE): Seeing a sharp tail spike starting ~10:02 UTC. p95 ~120ms -> 480ms, p99 ~1.1s -> 1.8s. Traffic is normal, error rates not elevated. Link to query: `avg_over_time(latency_ms[5m]) by (route)` shows /v1/generate leading.
dan (eng-runtime): Any signs of KV cache thrashing or coldstart storms? Streaming stalls metric also?
maria (prod): CS flagged a handful of slow webhooks and a timeout from big-customer (acct: acme-corp). No full outage reported, but increased complaints.
charles (support): Confirmed a ticket where embeddings timed out twice around the same timeframe, attaching logs in ticket #4359.
sre-oncall: Ok runbook quick checks: 1) check runtime pods for OOMs 2) check kv-cache hitrate 3) confirm tail latency on route-level pods 4) consider traffic shift to fallback model/region.
ops-bot: Runtime fleet health: 3 pods reporting high loop-latency on shard gpu-12 (pod ids: r-runtime-11, r-runtime-14, r-runtime-18). No restarts. KV cache hitrate for /v1/generate dropped 18% in the last 5m.
kim (SRE): Running a quick Loki query for stack traces; nothing obvious. I’m going to flip verbose tracing for one sampled request.
dan (eng-runtime): Prep traffic shift then. Suggest route fallback to cpu-optimized model variant (compatibility ok) to reduce tail. Command: `redwood route set --route /v1/generate --target model:fallback-small --weight 100 --reason "p99 spike"` — I'll stage it as 20% first.
sre-oncall: Hold 20% now, monitor p99 and error rates. If p99 drops and no errors, ramp to 100% for mitigation.
maria (prod): Notifying customer success and the impacted accounts list. I'll post a short status note if we mitigate.
charles (support): Ticket #4359 updated: "We see improvements after 20% shift, still seeing 500ms-1s for some calls".
ops-bot: Telemetry: after 20% shift at +120s p99 dropped from ~1.7s -> 550ms, p95 down to ~160ms. No increase in 5xx.
kim (SRE): Good signal. Will keep tracing sample on for another 3 minutes to verify no quality regressions.
dan (eng-runtime): Ramping to 100% fallback now (`redwood route set --route /v1/generate --target model:fallback-small --weight 100`).
sre-oncall: Confirming 100% rollout complete. Watching dashboards.
ops-bot: p99 now ~240ms, p95 ~140ms. KV cache hitrate still low but tail reduced.
maria (prod): CS: starting customer outreach for the accounts that filed tickets.
charles (support): Noting in ticket: mitigation applied, monitoring for recurrence.
kim (SRE): Next steps: 1) keep traffic on fallback while we root cause kernel-level latency on gpu-12 2) collect full KV cache metrics and model kernel traces 3) schedule follow-up postmortem if regression persists.
sre-oncall: Agree. I'll page runtime eng for kernel trace investigation and keep this thread as the live coordination channel. If we see p99 creep back up, we'll reopen paging.
incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity=sev2, mitigation=route-fallback, cust-impact=partial (timeouts and slow responses), responders=[sre-oncall, kim (SRE), dan (eng-runtime), maria (prod), charles (support)].
maria (prod): Thanks team — I'm closing customer-facing note for now and will update if anything changes.
sre-oncall: Closing the live mitigation stage. Logging follow-up actions and owners. If someone sees a reoccurrence ping @sre-oncall."
